title: A 90s Village Love Story 🌾🍛 a shared tiffin #shorts

segments.moment_description: Dawn: the couple sets out across the misty rice fields together, carrying the packed tiffin
He gently helps her across the little bamboo bridge over the stream
By the lotus pond he picks a white bloom and tucks it into her hair
Under the old banyan tree they share the home-cooked meal from the steel tiffin, overlooking the mustard fields
Golden dusk: they walk home together along the canal as the sun sets
